# Repository Instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md` as the canonical contract. At the start of work—and whenever Arthur says “lanjut” or “continue”—read `.agent/CURRENT_TASK.md`, `docs/agent/PROJECT_STATE.md`, `docs/agent/DECISIONS.md`, `docs/agent/OPEN_TASKS.md`, and inspect Git state. Load only task-relevant context, preserve unrelated dirty changes, make minimal diffs, and report actual verification. Ask before dependencies, migrations, deployment, publication, external communication, credentials/permissions, or destructive actions.
